args.title: Issue 4405: change src/components/ExportButton.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The src/components/ExportButton.tsx file manages the export format selection with a local React state and a default format set only on initialization; it does not remember the last export format used across page loads, which is why the menu resets to CSV each time. Adding a mechanism here to persist and recall the chosen export format from browser storage would solve the issue.
